adjudication.rationale: In sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the raw Fetch API `Response` from `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). Several call sites assume the returned value matches their provider refresh function’s return type/shape. This is directly broken for Google Calendar: it does `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); const token = res?.data;` (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts), but a `Response` has no `.data`, so `token` becomes `undefined` and `googleCredentials.access_token` / `expiry_date` are set to `undefined`. Other integrations (e.g., Office365/Zoom/Webex/Lark) pass that `Response` into provider-specific handlers (`handleErrorsJson`, `handleZoomResponse`, `handleWebexResponse`, `handleLarkError`) which expect the provider’s payload semantics; the diff shows no adaptation layer converting the sync endpoint response into those expected shapes.
